summary.text: Brian Kennedy is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 38 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 1989 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kennedy earned a B.A. in history and general social studies from Providence College in 1983 and an MBA from Anna Maria College in 1987.
He has worked as a real estate broker and appraiser for Kennedy Realty and Appraisal since 1986.
He began serving as a State Committeeman for District 16/38 in 1988.

In the 2021-2022 legislative session Kennedy was assigned to the Corporations Committee, the Innovation, Internet and Technology Committee, the House Rules Committee, the State Government and Elections Committee and the State Lottery Committee.
